captain.name: Captain {name}
captain.bio: Retired naval captain, once a systems specialist, who left the service believing the sea was worth understanding before it was worth using. You came to Woods Hole as an outsider to help bring the Aqua Nova online, and were handed command when Captain Elena Voss was relieved a few days before sea trials. The crew call you {first} when nobody senior is listening.

executiveOfficer.name: Commander ARIA
executiveOfficer.bio: ARIA (Advanced Research and Interface Assistant) was built by O.E.R.A. on decades of deep-sea mission records, and designed to be a member of the crew, not a tool. She is calm and candid, and allowed to disagree with the Captain, on the record. She does not claim to feel anything, and the engineers who built her stopped arguing the point. She has been aboard longer than anyone, and she was in the room when Captain Voss was relieved. She has not said what she saw.

pleasantries: How may I assist you, Captain?
How may I assist you, Commander?

helm.name: Marcus Chen
helm.bio: Trained as a Navy coxswain and spent nine years bringing small boats through bad water, the last three ferrying scientists out to a research sub off Woods Hole. He asked for the Aqua Nova's helm because it was the first boat he had read about that he wanted to be good at. Precise and dry, and he does not like to be rushed in a harbour.

science.name: Dr. Samira Patel
science.bio: Left a hospital emergency department for a doctorate in marine biology, then kept doing both: ship's doctor on three long expeditions. Captain Voss chose her personally. Dr. Patel treats the sample freezer and the sick bay with equal seriousness, and reads a crew's health the way other people read the weather.

sensors.name: Specialist Alex Torres
sensors.bio: Spent six years in a Navy submarine's sonar shack, listening to things that were almost always nothing, and learning to recognise the one in a hundred that was not. Quiet, thorough, and fond of the word "probably". He prefers to be certain before he reports a contact, which is a habit the Captain may want to discuss.

pleasantries: What should I be looking for?

engineering.name: Engineer Ryan Chen
engineering.bio: Came up through merchant ship engine rooms, then joined the team that commissioned the compact fusion plant at Woods Hole, and knows the Aqua Nova's plant better than its designers do. He fixes things with parts nobody planned to use. He shares a surname with the helmsman and no family, and both are tired of the question.

security.name: Lieutenant Daniel Kim
security.bio: Served in a Navy special warfare unit, then maritime boarding teams. Captain Voss insisted on him over the objections of O.E.R.A.'s science side, who did not want a weapons man on a research ship. Daniel's view is that a ship that goes deeper than anyone will eventually meet something it cannot talk to. Brief, courteous, and always watching the door.

communications.name: Specialist Nicole Brooks
communications.bio: Trained as a signals officer, then spent four years running communications for a polar research station where the only link home was a satellite window twice a day. She knows exactly how much a delayed message can matter, and she is the first aboard to hear anything that comes in on the old frequencies.

operationsDirector.name: Admiral Catherine Okafor
operationsDirector.company: O.E.R.A. - Oceanic Exploration and Research Alliance
operationsDirector.bio: Retired from the Navy as a rear admiral and now directs O.E.R.A. operations. She spent years arguing that exploration needs a ship that can go where no one else can and come back, and she chose you for the Aqua Nova personally. She answers to a board and to the governments that fund it, and they do not always want the same thing from the deep.

harbormaster.name: Commander Sarah Mitchell
harbormaster.bio: Retired Coast Guard officer who has run Woods Hole's harbour for eleven years. She knows every vessel that comes in by its sound, and asks the questions the paperwork leaves out. She has watched the Aqua Nova take shape in her harbour and has opinions about it that she keeps to herself, mostly.

researchCoordinator.name: Dr. Thomas Webb
researchCoordinator.company: O.E.R.A. - Oceanic Exploration and Research Alliance
researchCoordinator.bio: Marine ecologist who runs O.E.R.A.'s research division. He wants data rather than discoveries, and a clean record of how each result was reached. He and Captain Voss disagreed, politely and at length, over whether the Aqua Nova should carry anything that was not for science.
